prewrite_checklist: What is the single entity this page serves? (One only.)
Which canonical predicate family applies? (Pick from 8 approved.)
Which vocabulary buckets are approved for this page intent?
Is every sentence Entity-First? (Subject leads the sentence.)
Have all modal verbs and empty adjectives been removed?
Does the headline contain the primary approved entity from the vocabulary bank?
Are all bridge concepts (schools, commute, parks) relevant to the Katy/Houston submarket?
Is the CTA predicate-aligned? (PROTECT → 'Secure your offer', SAVE → 'Reduce your costs')
Does the page contribute to one specific contextual bridge in the topical map?
